items.title: lazing around with ramen
description: This piece celebrates Hokkaido ramen (北海道ラーメン), a world-famous culinary staple from Japan's northernmost prefecture. It highlights the region's rich noodle culture, specifically its hearty bowls of ramen that are celebrated for their diverse local flavors and high-quality ingredients sourced from the island's vast landscape.

The design features Rilakkuma sitting comfortably while holding a small, detailed bowl of ramen. The bowl is filled with noodles and topped with classic ingredients, looking like a warm and savory local meal.
The background art depicts a large, steaming bowl of ramen served with chopsticks against a warm orange backdrop, beautifully capturing the comforting and savory soul of this regional dish.
